controls.note: Use within-round control/plain and stages/plain. Either missing bound makes absolute stage durations exploratory. A dominant stage must still rank consistently across rounds, with computed wall share reported within timed replays.

target_selection: Report median per-call stage durations and median of per-replay shares, and largest stage counts; report grouped FFN and QKV too. Prefer a repeated large stage under different session counts for an implementation hypothesis. Distinguish mutually exclusive wall spans from separate CPU samples. Do not infer speedup from this profile.
